description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in Orleans, allowing the addition of startup tasks to the silo lifecycle at specified stages. It includes methods to add startup tasks via generic types, specific task instances, or delegate functions, and contains a private class implementing ILifecycleParticipant to manage task participation.

classes.name: SiloBuilderStartupExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to add startup tasks to the Orleans silo builder.

classes.name: StartupTask
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ILifecycleParticipant to execute startup tasks during the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Extension method to add a startup task of a specified type TStartup that implements IStartupTask, with an optional stage parameter.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Extension method to add a specific IStartupTask instance to the silo startup sequence, with an optional stage parameter.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Extension method to add a startup task defined as a delegate (Func<IServiceProvider, CancellationToken, Task>), with an optional stage parameter.
